# Regex Railway

> Turns a regular expression into a metro map and replays how a backtracking engine matches it against your text, step by step, with plain-English explanations and catastrophic-backtracking (ReDoS) detection.

- Built with React, TypeScript and Zustand: a hand-written regex parser, backtracking matcher and diagram layout engine.
- Every run is checked against the browser's own RegExp.
- No backend: patterns and text are shared through the URL fragment.
- Author: Harut Andreasyan, https://harut-andreasyan.vercel.app
